scope: Two explanation slides for implemented Lroom/Lpath, matching the user-provided factorized CTF estimator screenshot.

definitions.views: Same fixed room/microphone/two-RIR condition with different speech and speaker identities.
definitions.room_negatives: Both views of other batch items
definitions.path_positive: Same physical RIR in opposite view, after independent CTF PIT per view
definitions.path_negatives: Other path within the same item, both views; no paths from other items
definitions.projection: LN64, Linear64/64, SiLU, Linear64/32 per frequency; flatten ordered frequencies; L2 normalize
definitions.total: mean(Sweep v2 PIT view A, view B) + 0.01 Lroom + 0.01 Lpath

limitations: Room positives fix source positions too; position invariance is not imposed.
No claim of physically pure room/path disentanglement.
No new experimental scores are asserted; the screenshot results table is not reused as contrastive-learning results.

visual_revision.description: Minimal text, original factorized architecture drawn twice per slide for Data A and Data B, shared model weights. Dedicated Lroom and Lpath slides.
visual_revision.language: Japanese explanations; original English module labels
visual_revision.loss_comparison: Colored dashed lines connect corresponding embeddings across the two forward passes.
visual_revision.path_note: Path 1 illustrated; Path 2 follows the same rule.
